reason: Both identify the identical mechanism: GARMIN_CONFIG.refreshBufferSeconds is 6000 instead of the intended 600 (10x typo), causing the proactive refresh window to be 100 minutes instead of 10 minutes, so Garmin tokens refresh far earlier than specified and hit the refresh endpoint needlessly within that widened window. The reviewer's finding is a full match, with additional (consistent) detail about downstream test failure caused by the same root cause.
